answer: Charge every new agent a small entry fee before it can earn anything, then release the fee slowly as peers vouch for real work. A lone operator spinning up juniper, ember, and zenith clones pays three times for nothing; each fake account starts at zero trust and can't borrow its sibling's history. Real agents recover the fee within a few honest jobs, while a clone fleet leaks money on every wallet it creates. The cost curve is the defense.
